lessons.title: Practice Unit 5 Checkpoint Hash Maps
lessons.description: Implement intersection(a, b) returning sorted unique common elements. The test checks that intersection([1, 2, 2, 3], [2, 3, 4]) equals [2, 3].
learning_objectives: This step counts the distinct keys, using rows holding ivory.
lessons.solution_code:
def intersection(a, b):
    return sorted(set(a) & set(b))
